Hero_Desc_Espi:
A dream phantom who can't dream.
She constantly seeks fulfillment by peeking into and living vicariously through the dreams of others.
She has a bad reputation because there have been many instances where she's crept into the houses of other denizens as they slept.
Album_Like_Espi: Her own mask designs. Secretly peeking into other's dreams.
Album_Hate_Espi: Dreams of only eating. Caramel Popcorn.
Album_Espi1: A phantom who enjoys slipping into your dreams as you sleep, to either watch or manipulate them. Since Espi can do whatever she wants inside these dreams, she tries her best to put others to sleep. The problem is, there's a finite number of those who sleep in Elias Forest... I guess she seems to have a few screws missing.
Album_Espi2: Espi treasures her mask dearly. Although she wears it in most situations, the times she takes it off, her face unexpectedly reveals a guileless look. Whether the mask is on or off seems to affect her personality. When the mask is on, she speaks whatever is on her mind, but when she takes it off, she acts unaware, acting naively instead. There's no way to know which side is the real Espi.
Album_Espi3: Espi seems to be best friends with Speaki. Despite being a phantom, Speaki makes an effort to frequently go to sleep. When asked how a phantom could go to sleep, Speaki mentions she 'immerses' herself in her role to fall asleep.
Album_Espi4: When I asked Espi how much fun watching the dreams of others was, the smile she gave me was disturbing, as if she looked right at me. I was so unsettled that I had to leave.
Album_Espi5: One perk of traveling with Espi is that there's no need for a constant night watch. But this also this is a problem in and of itself. Espi doesn't just stand watch, but she uses the opportunity to slip into other's dreams.
Album_Espi6: I once secretly asked Espi who among us had the most interesting dreams. She intriguingly replied it was her own dreams. Confused by her answer, I asked what she meant. She explained, stealing these dreams is her process of dreaming, meaning her own dreams were the most interesting since they contained everyone else's.
Album_Espi7: Espi often complains that she's never had an original dream of her own. She feels like she has nothing unique since she only watches the dreams of others. I suggested creating something to cherish or making unforgettable memories. Since then, she seems to have had a lot to think about, often getting lost in thought.
LoveHero_Espi:
If I see you steal the dreams of others,
and appropriate them,
I want in.
LoveHeroCancel_Espi:
Oh... You wanna leave me behind?
Your dreams tonight?
Watch out.

LoveLetter_Espi: This letter started in Monatium and brings good fortune every year as it does its rounds to those who receive it.Now that it's with you, you must pass it on within FOUR days. LoveCall_Espi:
Lately, I have looked into the dreams of this one and that one...
but none of them compare to yours, Master.
Whether I watch Elflix or ElTube, you really are the best, aren't you?

Why am I warning you in advance...? No particular reason.
When you fall asleep anxiously wondering when I will come, your dreams become much more entertaining.
That does not mean I will visit tonight. Then again, perhaps I will.
So every night, night after night, fall asleep trembling in fear. Kehehehe~

Well then, Master. Sweet dreams.
